mechanism: Amoxicillin (beta-lactam) potentiates tobramycin (aminoglycoside) nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through synergistic effects on renal tubular cells and eighth cranial nerve damage.
action: Monitor renal function, serum creatinine, and auditory function closely; consider alternative antibiotics if prolonged combination therapy is necessary; maintain adequate hydration and avoid other nephrotoxic agents.
